title: uragoga scabriuscula
intro: Uragoga scabriuscula, commonly known as Uragoga, is a plant species belonging to the family of Urticaceae and native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic effects. The therapeutic actions of Uragoga include pain relief, wound healing, and treatment of fever, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
